channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Trajan Langdon | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Trajan Langdon from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: JB Bickerstaff on Trajan Langdon, Tom Gores
item.description:
“For us as coaches, we are trying to figure out, 'What is my job? What are the expectations? And how do I continue to move those expectations forward?' The best organization in this league is the team that is the most consistent. When things get rocky, they hunker down on the things they believe in, the people they believe in and the players they believe in. ... I am truly blessed to be where I am with Trajan Langdon and Tom Gores. They are the type of people who, when things get tough, have my back and have shown that.”

JB Bickerstaff on Trajan Langdon, Tom Gores, Jun 4, 2025. Source: Detroit News.

item.title: Tom Gores on Trajan Langdon, Tim Hardaway, Tobias Harris, Tim Hardaway Jr, Malik Beasley, Paul Reed
item.description:
“Tobias Harris, whom I've known for a long time. We've got Malik Beasley, Tim Hardaway Jr, and Paul Reed coming in. I feel very good about the offseason with the veterans. I think Trajan Langdon did a good job bringing the right people in, but still keeping flexibility.”

Tom Gores on Trajan Langdon, Tim Hardaway, Tobias Harris, Tim Hardaway Jr, Malik Beasley, Paul Reed, Oct 9, 2024. Source: Detroit News.

item.title: Tom Gores on Trajan Langdon
item.description:
Gores:

“I don’t think we’ve had the caliber of leadership as we have with Trajan. I looked at this as Trajan as a CEO.”

Tom Gores on Trajan Langdon, Jun 21, 2024. Source: Twitter @omarisankofa.

item.title: Tom Gores on Trajan Langdon
item.description:
#Pistons Tom Gores:

“One of the things that we've really missed -- and I take some responsibility for that -- is a leader who can lead everyone... one who can truly thread together and align people. That's what I was impressed by Trajan about.”

Tom Gores on Trajan Langdon, Jun 21, 2024. Source: Twitter @detnewsRodBeard.

item.title: Tom Gores on Trajan Langdon
item.description:
“I knew Trajan was universally praised and respected around the league, but as I spent time with him, he articulated a thoughtful, detailed plan to create a culture of winning and getting the best out of the talented people we have in our organization.”

Tom Gores on Trajan Langdon, May 31, 2024. Source: NBA.com.

item.title: Larry Nance Jr on Trajan Langdon
item.description:
Jim Eichenhofer:Larry Nance Jr. on atmosphere around #Pelicans:

“This is a great locker room. Griff, Trajan and those guys have done an unbelievable job of getting great people first. We see what they can do on the court, but each and every one of them is a great person in their own right.”

Larry Nance Jr on Trajan Langdon, Mar 23, 2022. Source: Twitter @Jim_Eichenhofer.

item.title: Mike Krzyzewski on Trajan Langdon
item.description:
Mike Krzyzewski:

“I talked to Trajan Langdon, the GM of the Pelicans (and former Duke player). He’s raved about Jah. He still has to transform his game to the NBA. As far as a role model (he’s been) the best. Not (just) good. I’m proud of him, because he’s learned from the mistakes he made. It’s not on the 76ers. It’s on him, and he’s taken responsibility. Once he took responsibility it was the start of him changing and conquering some of the bad habits he had.”

Mike Krzyzewski on Trajan Langdon, May 8, 2020. Source: Sports Illustrated.

item.title: David Griffin on Trajan Langdon
item.description:
Oleh Kosel:David Griffin on Trajan Langdon:

“It's really exciting for me to be able to announce Trajan Langdon as the new general manager... I think this falls in line with attracting the best and brightest.”

David Griffin on Trajan Langdon, May 21, 2019. Source: Twitter @OlehKosel.

item.title: David Griffin on Trajan Langdon
item.description:
David Griffin:

“Trajan is a tremendous talent and shares in our vision of what it means to be a part of the Pelican family, on and off the floor. We are excited to add he and his family to our leadership group as we continue building upon that vision.”

David Griffin on Trajan Langdon, May 19, 2019. Source: NBA.com.
